patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I got the cartilage done at the mall two weeks ago. It's hot and it really hurts, and my mom is being extremely I-told-you-so about the whole thing.
clinical.presentationShort: 17yo F — 4 days of localised redness and tenderness at a helix cartilage piercing. No fluctuance, no fever, no spreading erythema.
clinical.presentationLong: 17-year-old female with four days of localised redness and tenderness around a cartilage ear piercing, without fluctuance, fever or spreading redness.

diagnosis.primary: Perichondritis at a cartilage ear piercing
diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → remove the jewellery, antibiotics with pseudomonal cover, ENT follow-up
diagnosis.why: Cartilage infections are not ordinary soft-tissue infections. Perichondritis needs pseudomonal cover and close follow-up, or the ear can deform permanently.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 17-year-old girl in a denim jacket with her hair tucked behind one ear, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with her head tilted slightly, hair held back to expose the upper ear. Expression: irritated and a little sheepish. Clearly visible: the upper rim of one ear red and swollen around a small stud; hair tucked back to expose the ear. Overall: entirely well, sore ear. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
